# Psychology.com.my

> Malaysia's leading psychology and counseling center offering comprehensive mental health services, psychiatric care, and evidence-based therapy for adults, children, and specialized populations.

International Psychology Centre provides professional psychological assessment, counseling, and psychiatric services across Malaysia. The center specializes in treating mental health disorders including anxiety, depression, ADHD, autism, OCD, and personality disorders using evidence-based approaches like CBT and behavioral therapy.

## Key Topics

- Mental Health Malaysia
- Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT)
- ADHD Assessment & Treatment
- Autism Spectrum Disorder
- Depression Treatment
- Anxiety Disorders
- Psychological Assessment
- Behavioral Therapy
- Adult Counseling
- Child & Adolescent Psychiatry
- OCD Treatment
- Insomnia & Sleep Disorders
- Dyslexia Assessment
- Asperger's Syndrome
- Borderline Personality Disorder

- [About Us](https://psychology.com.my/About-Us): International Psychology Centre, Dr Edward Chan, team credentials, and organization overview
- [Services Overview](https://psychology.com.my/Services): Main services: therapy, counseling, family services, and addiction treatment

## Psychiatric Services

- [Adult Psychiatry](https://psychology.com.my/Adult-Psychiatry): Adult psychiatry services: ADHD, anxiety, depression, schema therapy
- [Child & Adolescent Psychiatry](https://psychology.com.my/Child-&-Adolescent-Psychiatry): Child and adolescent services: autism, ADHD, dyslexia, behavioral therapy
- [Women Psychiatric Services](https://psychology.com.my/Women-Psychiatric-Services): Specialized psychiatric care for women: postpartum, mood and anxiety disorders

## Counseling & Therapy

- [Adult Counseling](https://psychology.com.my/Adult-Psychology-and-Counseling): Adult counseling: depression, anxiety, stress management, psychological testing

## Mental Health Treatment Guides

- [ADD Treatment & Assessment](https://psychology.com.my/Cure-for-your-ADD): ADD treatment guide: assessment, behavioral therapy, medication alternatives
- [Anxiety Treatment & Assessment](https://psychology.com.my/Cure-For-Your-Anxiety): Anxiety treatment guide: GAD, panic disorder, PTSD, causes and therapy methods
- [Depression Treatment & Assessment](https://psychology.com.my/Cure-For-Your-Depression): Depression treatment guide: symptoms, diagnosis, assessment, mental health education
- [OCD Treatment & Assessment](https://psychology.com.my/Cure-for-Your-OCD): OCD treatment guide: assessment, obsessions, compulsions, psychological therapy
- [Phobia Treatment & Therapy](https://psychology.com.my/Cure-For-Your-Phobia): Phobia treatment guide: types, symptoms, therapy for arachnophobia and social phobia
- [Insomnia Treatment & Solutions](https://psychology.com.my/Cure-for-Insomnia): Insomnia treatment guide: sleep disorders, CBT, hypnotherapy, sleep remedies

## Neurodevelopmental & Personality Disorders

- [Autism Treatment & Assessment](https://psychology.com.my/Autism-Treatment-and-Assessment): Autism treatment guide: ASD diagnosis, early intervention, behavioral therapy
- [Dyslexia Treatment & Assessment](https://psychology.com.my/Adult-Dyslexia-Treatment-and-Assessment): Dyslexia assessment and treatment: therapeutic programmes, reading intervention
- [Asperger's Syndrome Treatment & Assessment](https://psychology.com.my/Adult-Asperger-Syndrome-Treatment-and-assessment): Asperger's syndrome in adults: diagnosis, symptoms, treatment, social interaction
- [Borderline Personality Disorder Treatment](https://psychology.com.my/Borderline-Personality-Disorder-Treatment-Assessment): BPD treatment guide: symptoms, emotional regulation, psychiatric care in Malaysia

## Other Disorders & Conditions

- [Eating Disorders](https://psychology.com.my/Feeding-and-eating-disorders): Eating disorders guide: anorexia, bulimia, binge-eating, diagnosis and treatment
- [Sleep-Wake Disorders](https://psychology.com.my/Sleep-wake-disorders): Sleep-wake disorders guide: insomnia, sleep apnea, restless legs syndrome
